Status: current

    },
    "RunPurpose": {
      "description": "Why a run was started.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "start",
          "description": "First run of a job.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "continue",
          "description": "Continue a job run that made progress.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "fix",
          "description": "Fix round after a failed verify.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "verify",
          "description": "Verify another job.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "plan",
          "description": "Plan work.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "keep",
          "description": "Diagnose stalled or failed jobs.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "capsule",
          "description": "Write a capsule.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "probe",
          "description": "Probe a limited provider.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "merge",
          "description": "Merge work.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "gate",
          "description": "Evaluate gates.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "SecretName": {
      "description": "A validated secret name: `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$`.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "SessionId": {
      "description": "Session id: 26-character ULID.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "StopReason": {
      "description": "Why a turn ended.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "end_turn",
          "description": "The model finished its turn normally.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "max_turns",
          "description": "The harness hit its maximum turn count.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "limit",
          "description": "A provider limit stopped the turn.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "error",
          "description": "The harness reported an error.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "interrupted",
          "description": "A human or the supervisor interrupted the turn.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "crash",
          "description": "The harness process crashed.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "SurfaceId": {
      "description": "A surface instance id (ULID, 26 characters).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "SurfaceScope": {
      "description": "One capability granted to a surface token.\n\nThe wire form is one short string, for example `session.read:<id>`, `session.write:<id>`,\n`project.read:<name>`, `fleet.read` or `tool:<name>`. The store keeps the list in\n`surface_tokens.scopes_json`; unknown scopes are preserved verbatim so a newer home can\nextend the vocabulary without breaking older readers.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "Timestamp": {
      "description": "A UTC instant with millisecond precision.\n\nThe wire/DB form is RFC 3339 with a `Z` suffix and exactly three fractional digits,\nfor example `2026-11-08T19:25:47.123Z`.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "Tokens": {
      "description": "Token usage broken down by kind.",
      "properties": {
        "cache_read": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Tokens read from the prompt cache.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "cache_write": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Tokens written to the prompt cache.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "input": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Non-cached input tokens.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "output": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Output tokens.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "reasoning": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Reasoning tokens, when the harness reports them separately.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "TurnSummary": {
      "description": "The terminal summary an agent sends in [`AgentFrame::TurnEnd`].",
      "properties": {
        "cost": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Cost",
          "description": "Cost and token usage reported by the harness."
        },
        "exit_code": {
          "description": "Process exit code, when the harness produced one.",
          "format": "int32",
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "limit": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/LimitEvent"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Provider limit that ended the run, when one was classified."
        },
        "native_session_id": {
          "description": "Harness-side session id, when one was reported.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "outcome": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/RunOutcome",
          "description": "Classified run outcome."
        },
        "result_text": {
          "description": "Final assistant text, when any.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "stop_reason": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/StopReason",
          "description": "Why the run stopped."
        },
        "usage": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/RemoteUsage"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Resource usage measured on the agent, when available."
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "outcome",
        "cost",
        "stop_reason"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "UsageSource": {
      "description": "Where a [`RunUsage`] row came from.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "cgroup",
          "description": "Measured through a cgroup v2 scope.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "proc_tree",
          "description": "Measured by walking the process tree under `/proc`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "default",
          "description": "The compiled default because neither measurement was available.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "description": "One agent protocol frame, tagged by `type`.",
  "oneOf": [
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: identity and capabilities.",
      "properties": {
        "agent_version": {
          "description": "Agent binary version.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "arch": {
          "description": "CPU architecture.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "capabilities": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/AgentCapabilities",
          "description": "Names-only capabilities."
        },
        "key_id": {
          "description": "Public-key id.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "labels": {
          "description": "Owner-assigned labels.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "node": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/NodeName",
          "description": "Node name."
        },
        "os": {
          "description": "Operating system name.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "agent_hello",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "node",
        "key_id",
        "agent_version",
        "os",
        "arch",
        "labels",
        "capabilities"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the nonce and limits for authentication.",
      "properties": {
        "connection_id": {
          "description": "Connection identity.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "heartbeat_secs": {
          "description": "Heartbeat interval in seconds.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "home_id": {
          "description": "Home identity.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "max_frame_bytes": {
          "description": "Maximum accepted frame size in bytes.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "nonce": {
          "description": "One-time nonce.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "server_time": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Timestamp",
          "description": "Home server time."
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "home_challenge",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "nonce",
        "home_id",
        "connection_id",
        "server_time",
        "heartbeat_secs",
        "max_frame_bytes"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: signature over the challenge.",
      "properties": {
        "signature": {
          "description": "Lowercase hex signature.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "agent_auth",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "signature"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the handshake succeeded.",
      "properties": {
        "connection_id": {
          "description": "Connection identity.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "home_id": {
          "description": "Home identity.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "node": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/NodeName",
          "description": "Node name."
        },
        "protocol": {
          "description": "Negotiated protocol.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "home_welcome",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "protocol",
        "home_id",
        "node",
        "connection_id"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: redeem a one-time enrollment code.",
      "properties": {
        "agent_version": {
          "description": "Agent binary version.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "arch": {
          "description": "CPU architecture.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "capabilities": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/AgentCapabilities",
          "description": "Names-only capabilities."
        },
        "code": {
          "description": "One-time enrollment code; never logged.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "labels": {
          "description": "Owner-assigned labels.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "os": {
          "description": "Operating system name.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "paths": {
          "description": "Initial project path map.",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/AgentPathMap"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "public_key": {
          "description": "Lowercase hex ed25519 public key.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "enroll",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "code",
        "public_key",
        "agent_version",
        "os",
        "arch",
        "labels",
        "capabilities",
        "paths"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: enrollment succeeded.",
      "properties": {
        "heartbeat_secs": {
          "description": "Heartbeat interval in seconds.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "home_id": {
          "description": "Home identity.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "node": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/NodeName",
          "description": "Node name."
        },
        "protocol": {
          "description": "Negotiated protocol.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "server_time": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Timestamp",
          "description": "Home server time."
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "enrolled",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "home_id",
        "node",
        "protocol",
        "server_time",
        "heartbeat_secs"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: redeem a one-time pairing code for a local surface.",
      "properties": {
        "app": {
          "description": "Application name, for example `opencode`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "code": {
          "description": "One-time pairing code; never logged or echoed.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "session": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SessionId",
          "description": "Session the surface will mirror."
        },
        "surface_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceId",
          "description": "Surface the owner created on the home."
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "surface_pair",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "code",
        "surface_id",
        "session",
        "app"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the pairing succeeded and issued a token.",
      "properties": {
        "expires_at": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Timestamp",
          "description": "When the token expires."
        },
        "scopes": {
          "description": "Scopes granted to the token.",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceScope"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "surface_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceId",
          "description": "Surface the token belongs to."
        },
        "token": {
          "description": "Secret token; write it 0600, never log or echo it.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "surface_issued",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "surface_id",
        "token",
        "scopes",
        "expires_at"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the surface token was revoked; detach and delete it.",
      "properties": {
        "reason": {
          "description": "Human-readable reason.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "surface_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceId",
          "description": "Surface whose token was revoked."
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "surface_revoked",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "surface_id",
        "reason"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: acquire or take over the session lease.",
      "properties": {
        "mode": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/LeaseMode",
          "description": "Whether a live lease may be replaced."
        },
        "session": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SessionId",
          "description": "Session the lease protects."
        },
        "surface": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceId",
          "description": "Surface asking for the lease."
        },
        "surface_token": {
          "description": "Scoped surface token issued by `SurfaceIssued`; never logged.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "lease_acquire",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "surface",
        "session",
        "surface_token",
        "mode"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: keep the held lease alive.",
      "properties": {
        "session": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SessionId",
          "description": "Session the lease protects."
        },
        "surface": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceId",
          "description": "Surface holding the lease."
        },
        "token": {
          "description": "Plaintext lease token returned by `LeaseGrant`; never logged.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "lease_heartbeat",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "surface",
        "session",
        "token"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: release the lease on detach.",
      "properties": {
        "session": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SessionId",
          "description": "Session the lease protects."
        },
        "surface": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceId",
          "description": "Surface releasing the lease."
        },
        "token": {
          "description": "Plaintext lease token returned by `LeaseGrant`; never logged.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "lease_release",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "surface",
        "session",
        "token"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the lease is granted for this surface.",
      "properties": {
        "expires_at": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Timestamp",
          "description": "When the lease goes stale without a heartbeat."
        },
        "lease_token": {
          "description": "Plaintext lease token; shown once in the grant, never logged.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "tail_seq": {
          "description": "Session sequence the new holder may continue from.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "lease_grant",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "lease_token",
        "expires_at",
        "tail_seq"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the lease was taken over or expired; the surface is read-only.",
      "properties": {
        "reason": {
          "description": "Human-readable reason.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "lease_lost",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "reason"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: another surface now holds the lease; stop sending events.",
      "properties": {
        "holder": {
          "description": "Human-visible holder of the lease now.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "reason": {
          "description": "Human-readable reason.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "lease_revoked",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "reason",
        "holder"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: capacity and spool state.",
      "properties": {
        "at": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Timestamp",
          "description": "When the heartbeat was sent."
        },
        "capacity": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/AgentCapacity",
          "description": "Latest capacity snapshot."
        },
        "pending_spool_bytes": {
          "description": "Bytes waiting in the pending spool.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "heartbeat",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "at",
        "capacity",
        "pending_spool_bytes"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: liveness probe.",
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "const": "ping",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: liveness reply.",
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "const": "pong",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the node credential was revoked.",
      "properties": {
        "reason": {
          "description": "Human-readable reason.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "revoked",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "reason"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: another connection took over.",
      "properties": {
        "connection_id": {
          "description": "Connection that superseded this one.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "superseded",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "connection_id"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: protocol or policy error.",
      "properties": {
        "kind": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ErrorKind",
          "description": "Error class."
        },
        "message": {
          "description": "Human-readable message.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "retryable": {
          "description": "Whether a retry may succeed.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "error",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "kind",
        "message",
        "retryable"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: start one local chat turn after the lease was granted.",
      "properties": {
        "cwd_ref": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/PathRef",
          "description": "Project-relative working directory; the agent resolves it locally."
        },
        "executor": {
          "description": "Executor string, for example `opencode:deepseek/deepseek-flash#max`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "job": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/JobId"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Job the run belongs to, when the session is job-scoped."
        },
        "lease_token": {
          "description": "Plaintext lease token returned by `LeaseGrant`; never logged.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "prompt": {
          "description": "Prompt for this turn.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "purpose": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/RunPurpose",
          "description": "Why the run starts."
        },
        "session": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SessionId",
          "description": "Session the turn continues."
        },
        "surface": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceId",
          "description": "Paired surface that owns the turn."
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "turn_begin",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "surface",
        "session",
        "lease_token",
        "prompt",
        "executor",
        "cwd_ref",
        "purpose"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the turn started and the run id is assigned.",
      "properties": {
        "expires_at": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Timestamp",
          "description": "When the lease goes stale without a heartbeat."
        },
        "lease_token": {
          "description": "Lease token for the run; the same value the agent presented.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "run_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/RunId",
          "description": "Run id assigned by the home."
        },
        "session": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SessionId",
          "description": "Session the run belongs to."
        },
        "tail_seq": {
          "description": "Last session sequence the agent may continue from.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "turn_grant",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "run_id",
        "session",
        "lease_token",
        "expires_at",
        "tail_seq"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: one v0.2 remote line wrapped with its run and epoch.",
      "properties": {
        "epoch": {
          "description": "Run epoch; a later frame with another epoch is fenced.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "line": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/RemoteLine",
          "description": "The v0.2 event, heartbeat or summary line."
